**Score status: REPRODUCIBLE**

CN #25 had an explicit seven-day machine freeze aligned with completed W37. Its five structural calls can therefore be audited against final Master Monday evidence.

| Component | Score | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| Structural | **90%** | Four supported calls, one mixed, none contradicted |

| Decision utility | Unavailable | No execution outcome or scoring rubric was supplied |

The structural audit uses supported = 1, mixed = 0.5, and contradicted = 0. Four calls were supported. The granular call covering midcap, small-cap, and microcap transmission was mixed because weak proxy breadth supports its direction, but incomplete outcome ingestion did not independently establish every tier. The unresolved and volatile-transition call held up: BTC and ETH finished W37 net-negative after a midweek drawdown and partial recovery, without a confirmed breakdown or broad risk expansion. Weak proxy breadth also supported the forecasts that ETH leadership would remain narrow and broad altseason would stay inactive.

### What went wrong

CN #25 did not explicitly forecast that both BTC and ETH would finish the week net-negative or emphasize the realized drawdown strongly enough. Its granular claim that rotation would not transmit through every smaller-cap tier was directionally consistent with weak breadth but only partly testable because completed-week outcome ingestion was incomplete.

No BTC or ETH ranges were published. Those fields were frozen as null, so there is no range miss, but there is also no hit credit or price-precision evidence.
